snippet.title: "Fate/EXTRA Record" Character Introduction Trailer(Lil' Ronnie Faction)
snippet.description:
Lil' Ronnie（VA: Yu Kobayashi）
An odd person who wears a clown mask. She speaks in an unusual manner, constantly repeating strange words. The only thing known about her is that she is searching for something "delicious."

Lil' Ronnie's Servant（VA: Hisao Egawa）
A knight who constantly repeats violent and incoherent remarks. Is his blood-soaked cloak a symbol of historic battles, or something else...?

The Moon Holy Grail War Reborn ---

Fate/EXTRA Record is coming to PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Nintendo Switch™ 2, Nintendo Switch™, and Steam® worldwide on January 28, 2027!

Physical editions are available for pre-order now.
Digital pre-orders will be available on each platform at a later date.
